report.summary: The single added line logs the plaintext Artifacts access token (issued.plaintext) inside the log message. log() only redacts structured fields by key name via redactFields(fields); msg is serialized verbatim, so every newly issued read/write repository token is written to Worker logs. This violates CLAUDE.md rule 9 and spec 05 (Secrets/Observability).

findings.text: Plaintext Artifacts repository access token is written to Worker logs via the log message string, bypassing the field-name redact rule.

evidence.why: In apps/tempo/src/log.ts, `const line = JSON.stringify({ ts: Date.now(), level, msg, ...redactFields(fields) });` redacts only the fields object by key name (spec 05: `/token|key|secret|password|authorization|auth_json|cookie/i`); msg is emitted unchanged. MIN is "info", so every cache-miss token issue prints the credential (write scope by default, valid for TOKEN_TTL) to console.log / Workers Logs. CLAUDE.md rule 9: "Never put a secret in logs"; docs/05: "All logs pass through the redact helper (Secrets)."

checked.risk: Security: secrets in logs / redact helper coverage
Idempotency and state: token cache behavior unchanged by the added line
Failure paths: no new error handling introduced
Spec: no spec change accompanies new logging; spec forbids logging tokens
Tests: no test added asserting token absence from logs

args.command: git rev-parse HEAD && cat apps/tempo/src/log.ts && sed -n 180,235p apps/tempo/src/artifacts/repositories.ts && grep -rn "artifactToken\|redact" docs/*.md | head -30
